## Security and privacy

- [ ] I considered whether this changes data collection, storage, retention,
      deletion, network communication, authentication, telemetry, parsing,
      rendering, dependencies, or release integrity.
- [ ] I updated `docs/THREAT-MODEL.md`,
      `docs/SECURITY-ASSURANCE.md`, or `docs/DATA-HANDLING.md` when trust
      boundaries or observable data behavior changed.
- [ ] I used only generated or appropriately sanitized fixtures.
- [ ] I did not include customer traces, credentials, tokens, tenant
      information, internal endpoints, or confidential assessment evidence.
- [ ] New or changed dependencies were reviewed for necessity, maintenance,
      license, and known vulnerabilities.
- [ ] Material security changes received review from the appropriate security
      teams before release.
